gameInstructions: Put the response in order: listen, gather, then go.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Deborah sent for Barak and gave him God’s command: gather ten thousand and march to Mount Tabor.

lines.speaker: barak
lines.text: If you go with me, I will go; but if you do not go with me, I will not go.

lines.speaker: deborah
lines.text: Certainly I will go with you.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Deborah rose to share the road, while making clear that the victory would not become Barak’s glory.

gameSuccess: The message reaches Barak, and courage begins with a shared road.
name: Ch.2 · The Summons
